input.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

sub_goals.text: Gather ingredients and prepare food processor parts.
Attempt to assemble the food processor blade.
Find the correct piece and figure out the assembly.
Wash and dry the center piece of the food processor.
Assemble the food processor blade and plug in the appliance.
Test the food processor and prepare it for use.
Add the first batch of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the first batch of biscuits.
Add more biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second batch of biscuits.
Add the remaining biscuits from the first packet and crush them.
Add a second packet of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second packet of biscuits.

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

events.description: Place the biscuit packets on the counter.
events.relevance: brings the main ingredient to the workspace

events.description: Place the food processor bowl on the counter.
events.relevance: prepares the appliance needed for crushing

events.description: Insert the blade into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: attempts to set up the crushing mechanism

events.description: Pick up the center spindle piece.
events.relevance: retrieves the missing part required for assembly

events.description: Wash the spindle under the running tap.
events.relevance: cleans the part before it touches food

events.description: Sound of running water from the tap.
Dry the spindle with a towel.
events.relevance: removes water before placing it in the appliance

events.description: Insert the spindle and blade into the food processor bowl.
Plug the power cord into the wall outlet.
Press the button on the food processor base.
events.relevance: activates the motor to test it

events.description: Sound of the food processor motor running empty.
Open the biscuit packet.
Drop biscuits into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: loads the first batch of ingredients

events.description: Place the lid on the food processor bowl.
Press the button to run the processor.
Loud crunching sound of biscuits being crushed.
events.relevance: indicates the biscuits are breaking down

events.description: Remove the lid from the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: opens the bowl to add more

events.description: Drop more biscuits into the bowl.
Place the lid back on the bowl.
Press the button to run the processor.
Pour the remaining biscuits from the packet into the bowl.
Press the button to crush the remaining biscuits.
Open the second packet of biscuits.
Pour biscuits from the second packet into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds the final batch of biscuits

events.description: Press the button to run the processor.
Sound of crushing biscuits.
events.relevance: indicates the final crushing is happening

relations.ask: Why was the spindle dried before being inserted into the bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The spindle was washed and needed to be dried before assembly.

relations.ask: What allowed the food processor to turn on when the button was pressed?
relations.answer_hint: The power cord was plugged into the outlet.

relations.ask: What is being crushed when the button is pressed?
relations.answer_hint: The first batch of biscuits that were dropped into the bowl.

relations.ask: How does the state of the biscuits in the bowl change before more are added?
relations.answer_hint: The first batch of biscuits was crushed into crumbs.

relations.ask: What is being crushed in this step?
relations.answer_hint: The additional biscuits that were just dropped into the bowl.

relations.ask: What is being crushed when the processor is run this time?
relations.answer_hint: The biscuits poured from the second packet.

decision_points.why: Deciding to start assembling the appliance after gathering the parts.
Realizing a piece is missing or incorrect and deciding to find the right one.
Deciding the spindle needs to be washed before it can be used.
Resuming the assembly process now that the part is clean.
Deciding to test the appliance empty to ensure it works before adding food.
Starting the actual food processing task by adding the first ingredient.
Deciding to crush the first batch rather than filling the bowl completely.
Deciding to process the biscuits in batches and adding the next round.
Simply repeating the crushing action for the newly added batch.
Continuing the established batching and crushing process for the first packet.
Deciding that more biscuits are needed for the recipe and opening a second packet.
Repeating the crushing action for the second packet.
Deciding the biscuits are sufficiently crumbled and the task is complete.
